items.title: Edward "Noon" Johnson Interview, 1960-05-28
items.q: I know one time I was playing with little Charlie, he was on drums.

ctx.x: I know it's hard to remember all those names. I was pretty young man. Do you remember who else was with Kid Rene when you'd play with him sometime?
I'm trying to think now. I know one time I was playing with little Charlie, he was on drums. I was a wonderful drummer before he kind of moved in my mind.
Did his brother Joe Rene ever play with you too?
